CyberBoroshno reports the Flamingo strike on Progress Rocket Center hit building 106A, which assembles electronics and control systems for Soyuz rockets. Building 106B for final assembly is nearby. This is Russia's only serial assembly point for the entire Soyuz-2 lineup used for military orbital missions like Liana reconnaissance and Persona/Razdan optical intel, plus Rassvet satellite internet, the analysts note. No backup exists. Repairs could take months due to cleanroom requirements and sanctions on electronics components, analysts explain. Fire, smoke and water damage means recertification of clean zones and tech processes. Without this facility, rockets can't be assembled even when fuel tanks are ready.
